Afrexai Event Management 1.0.0

- Initial public release of a comprehensive event management and conference planning system.
- Includes templates for event strategy, budgeting, venue selection, sponsorship, and speaker management.
- Offers detailed YAML schemas and decision matrices to standardize event planning processes.
- Provides actionable checklists and pricing strategies for various event formats (in-person, virtual, hybrid).
- Features go/no-go scorecards and risk criteria to help teams validate and refine event concepts.
